name: Eval runs
oneLiner: a glass eval table of test cases: Run is pressed, a scan bar steps down the rows as each one spins and lands a green Pass or a grey Fail, a segmented bar fills under them, and the score counts up big and lands with the status flipping to a green Complete
say: when the speaker says they tested the prompt or agent before trusting it ('I ran it against fifty test cases', 'it passed five out of six'): the run starts on 'tested', the score lands on the number
